title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1982-04-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/24 (1 DVD FLAC)
source: (FOB/13th Row) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Sony FeCr90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding recording despite a reportedly underwhelming performance, leaving fans with mixed feelings.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its crystal‑clear mix and the way the post‑production makes the band sound right, earning high marks from one reviewer. However, another contributor criticizes the show itself (and even mentions taping issues), resulting in an overall mixed reception.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 5‑star review praises the recording, while a second gives a 0 rating and offers no detail on sound quality; averaging these divergent scores yields a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers highlight that the mix sounds right, with clear instrument separation and good overall fidelity. No specific flaws or drop‑outs are mentioned.
